title: Morphing Blocks
description:
Morphing Blocks is a game collection built around blocks and creative modes. It includes 42 different types of games: jump in from the Hub with one click—puzzles, arcade, pinball, strategy, board, and casual play, all in one place.Содержание• Magic Cube — Regular, special, and high-order cubes; swipe layers to restore.

• Nonogram — Classic picross / nonogram; 100 picture levels.

• 0248 Blocks — Color merge play; default 4 / 5 / 6 board sizes.

• Zuma — Shoot matching jelly colors to clear chains; 100 levels.

• Strongman — Creative versus play—shove pieces off the board along a line; 330 distinct openings.

• Map Tower Defense — Place turrets on yellow map cells; 100 maps, wave defense on each.

• Block Conveyor — Pull parts from the belt to complete target products and ship them as difficulty rises (includes endless difficulty).

• Tank Battle — Classic tank stages; 50 levels, defend Headquarters.

• Magic Mirror — Mirrored dual-screen Tetris; tough creative 20-level campaign + endless mode.

• Infection — Claim the board by adjacent copy / leap infection—a creative new game; 492 layouts.

• Rainbow Chess — A creative battlefield chess game where you build your own lineup.

• Number Blocks — Sliding number puzzle: order the tiles; multiple board sizes and difficulties.

• Slot Machine — A slot-machine game with roguelike, level-based builds.

• Emoji Blocks — A Balatro-style block game with tons of items and unique block skills to choose from.

• Block Klotski — Slide colorful pieces and escort the highlighted block out the bottom exit; 46 levels.

• Block Puzzle — Fill the target area with multi-color blocks; includes a level designer for custom challenges.

• Block Match — Plan your block stock to clear rows and color goals; 20 levels.

• Block Paintball — Aim with the cue block and sink each color into its matching pocket; 15 levels.

• Block Snake — Falling blocks plus snake control for score runs; 4-stage challenge.

• Block Tower Defense — An infinite centered map where multi-color defense blocks protect the core; optional 20-wave challenge.

• Block Maze — Classic fog-of-war maze with assorted items; find the single exit from the center; 20 levels.

• Block Pinball — Casual pinball clear-the-board with custom peg layouts; 8 levels.

• Grid Hide & Seek — Stealth hide-and-seek on a grid; includes a designer to save custom levels.

• Push Blocks — Large and small blocks shove each other around—hard puzzle play, push goal colors home; 15 levels.

• Gladiator Blocks — Competitive turn-based board control. A Go-like block board game.

• 4-Way Blocks — Blocks fall from four directions; clear rows and columns (endless casual mode available).

• Block Battle — Grid tank warfare: clear stages, power up, and watch the battlefield grow (endless progression).

• Nine — A Gomoku-style extension—connect nine in a row, column, or diagonal to win.

• Mahjong — Creative matching puzzle with a huge level set: tap tiles into a 7-slot bar and clear layer by layer.

• Neon Lights — Lights-out puzzles in multiple modes (mono / multi-color); 110 levels (normal/hard) + custom.

• Block Cube — Turn layers with arrows to restore specific face targets; 120 different puzzle levels.

• Block Twins — Two independent boards side by side—a fresh mode; 20-level campaign + endless mode.

• Block Shooter — Pilot a turret and shoot falling multi-cell block enemies (includes endless difficulty).

• Sokoban — Push colored crates into matching zones with the white block, within a move limit; 221 levels.

• Diamond — A classic dig-style remake: jump to capture pieces until one remains at the center; multiple boards for 2000+ levels.

• Block Match-3 — Goal-score match-3 with new creative rules; 200 levels.

• Order-6 Magic Square — Fill a 6×6 square with 1–36 so every row, column, and diagonal sums to 111.

• Chroma Snake — Eat matching colors to grow and recolor; smash mismatches for score.

• Minesweeper — Classic minesweeper; 30 levels across three board sizes.

• Block Color Crush — Casual same-color clear-the-board play.

• Sudoku — Classic 9×9 Sudoku; 600 levels in 6 difficulty tiers.

• Smart Partition — Pour between cups to hit the target volume; 20 puzzles.
Особенности• 42 standalone modes — From Klotski and Sokoban to tower defense, Sudoku, Zuma, and mahjong—one collection, all in one place.

• Serious level volume — Sokoban 221, Match-3 200, Neon puzzles 110, Map TD 100 maps, Diamond 2000+, and more.

• Colorful block flair — Distinct block looks and rich visual effects in every mode.

• Unified Hub — Preview and pick a game, then return anytime.

• Instant play — Glance at previews and jump into any mini-game in seconds.

• Ongoing updates — More mini-games planned in future versions.

Одна коллекция. Вернитесь к простой радости игры!

13 августа 2026 — Добавлены шесть новых мини-игр: 0248, Сапёр, Числовые пятнашки, Магический квадрат 6×6, Блочный пазл и Змейка со сменой цвета.
description_short: Сорок две мини-игры в разных стилях. Morphing Blocks — коллекция красочных блочных мини-игр: превью и запуск из центрального Hub — казуал, аркада, versus, tower defense, match-3 и головоломки.
